items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul Motian, who you met playing with Al Cohn and Zoot Sims primarily

ctx.x: Yes. He was a leader, and he worked at the Village Vanguard opposite Al and Zoot...
Well, these are people with whom you’d be playing with five or six years. They’d be hiring you.
